english: Scan the farmer's voucher, check their ID and hand over the cash. You cannot redeem a voucher for a household you registered or verified, and some vouchers are held for ops to redeem in person. Every scan is recorded with your name.

english: Six groups — person, household, farm, plot, crop cycle, expected harvest — created together in a single step. These chips show which groups you have filled in.

notes: Flag: Drafter: 'Chips' rendered as 'alama' (marks); six group names composed from glossary terms (msimu wa zao, kipande cha shamba, mavuno yanayotarajiwa are all [UNVERIFIED]).

english: Everything awaiting verification, in one list. Verifying says you have seen the record yourself. There is no way to un-verify, so leave anything you are unsure of.
